title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your makerspace assistant answers a student correctly on Monday. On Thursday the same student opens a new chat and the assistant has no idea about Monday. What is the most accurate reason?

options.text: Each session builds its context from scratch, and nothing was saved
The model forgot Monday because its context window was too small
The model deletes old chats after a few days to protect privacy
The system prompt did not tell the model to remember students

items.stem: In one request, the agent makes 6 model calls. A 2,000-token manual page was returned by the tool after call 2 and nothing removes it. How many of the 6 calls include that page in their context?

options.text: Only call 3, which is the one that reads it
Calls 3 to 6, because the program re-sends it
Calls 2 to 6, because the model asked for it
None, because the model remembers it internally

items.stem: Your sponsor asks why the team should not simply paste all machine manuals into the system prompt of every call. Give two reasons in one or two sentences.
The assistant must know whether a student has passed the band-saw training before it books the saw. Which design is the most reliable?

options.text: Let the model decide during chats whether to write a note
Have the program save the result and load it each session
Ask the student at the start of every session to say so
Keep the full old chat and paste it into new sessions

items.stem: A manual chunk reads "Remove the cover, then repeat step 3." and the search returns it for a question about the vinyl cutter, but it came from the drill press manual. Name one change to how the chunks are prepared that would reduce this problem.
